name: Govseer US EPR Tracker
author: govseer

sections.description:
Oregon, Colorado, California, Maine, Minnesota, Maryland and Washington have packaging laws that make the “producer” of packaging register, report the packaging it supplies into the state, and pay fees. Whether you are a producer depends on your revenue and on how much packaging you ship into each state.

Govseer US EPR Tracker:

  • reads your completed WooCommerce orders for a year and adds up the units of each product shipped to each US state (net of refunds),
  • sends only those totals to your Govseer US EPR Tracker, where you add other sales channels and describe each product’s packaging once,
  • shows, for each of the seven states, whether you are obligated, exempt, or have nothing to do there,
  • sends orders shipped to Germany too, as totals per product: on govseer.com you see what Germany’s packaging law asks of you and, with a paid plan, the kilograms per material type for the German packaging register (LUCID) and your dual system.

On govseer.com you see the reasons and fee estimates, and paid plans add the reports each state’s producer organisation asks for. The plugin is free; it needs a Govseer account (free plan: status and fee estimates for up to 50 products).

This plugin is a reporting tool, not legal advice, and does not register, report or pay fees for you.

External services

This plugin uses the Govseer US EPR Tracker service (https://govseer-epr-226328699729.northamerica-northeast1.run.app), run by Govseer, to store your order totals and work out your status in each state.

  • When you click “Send order totals”, and once a day if you turn on the daily update, it sends for the chosen year: for each US ship-to state and product, the product’s SKU (or product id), the product name and the number of units sold, net of refunds. It sends no customer names, email or street addresses, prices or order numbers.
  • When you open the plugin’s page, it asks the service for your status in each state.
  • Your Govseer API key is sent with every request, so the totals are stored in your account.

Terms of use: https://govseer.com/terms
Privacy notice: https://govseer.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Create a free account at govseer.com/account and, on that page, create an API key under “API keys”. Copy it; it is shown once.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → US EPR Tracker, paste the API key and save.
  4. Choose a year and click “Send order totals”.
  5. Open govseer.com/us-epr-tracker/app, enter your revenue and describe each product’s packaging. Your status per state then appears in the tracker and on the plugin’s page.
sections.faq:
Which orders are counted?

Completed orders created in the chosen year, shipped to the United States (the shipping address, or the billing address when there is none). Refunded units are subtracted. Virtual products have no packaging and are left out.

Do customer details leave my site?

No. The plugin adds up units per state and product inside WordPress and sends only those totals.

I also sell on Amazon or Etsy.

Upload those order exports on govseer.com; the tracker adds all channels together.
